blockingFindings.title: R1 empty text rejection is untested
blockingFindings.issue: The R1 test asserts rejection for an empty reference, unknown section, unknown obligation kind, non-positive caps, and a non-array entries collection, but it never asserts that RequirementContextEntry rejects empty text. R1 explicitly requires constructors to reject empty references/text.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion that constructing a RequirementContextEntry with a valid reference and empty text throws.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage, so an implementation that accepts empty context text could pass the current tests.

blockingFindings.title: R3 per-item 1000 character cap is not directly tested
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test creates long constraint entries and checks overall context length, truncation marker, source ordering, and section cap, but it does not assert that an individual rendered item is capped at MAX_REQUIREMENT_CONTEXT_ITEM_CHARS / 1000 characters. The test could pass if only whole-context truncation occurs while individual entries exceed the required per-item bound.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an assertion that a rendered long item is truncated at the deterministic per-item boundary and does not exceed 1000 characters before any marker/reference overhead expected by the API.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3's item-level cap is a required behavioral bound with no concrete spec-local regression test.
